### 2026-11-01: i had to choose beetween 2 interfaces one for temperature and the other for usage but to keep the project simple and easy i chose to only make the usage so for that reason i worked on both of the inte

**2h**

i had to choose beetween 2 interfaces one for temperature and the other for usage but to keep the project simple and easy i chose to only make the usage so for that reason i worked on both of the interfaces on a very usefull tool that i love (lopaka.app) that let's you draw stuff add animations etc... and export the code without having to later place pixel by pixel in the code so i first worked on the first interface which display cpu, gpu, ram and vram usage then worked on the temps interface too but later discarded it but i will include screenshots of both. Of course after i finished i exported the code wich i will need later.
